reason: The only device-limit test, database_test.go:51-70 (TestIntegrationBeyondDeviceLimit, limit 1), checks only that a second, new device gets ErrDeviceLimitReached. No test updates an already-known device at the limit or tries other limits, and impl_test.go:116 and :151 use setting.NewCfg(), so AnonymousDeviceLimit stays 0 and the limited path through the service, cache and client is never tested.
